extension.summary: Import widget backups and preloaded setups.
extension.description: Imports and exports portable widget backup ZIPs for Skin Shortcuts and Arctic Fuse 3 Skin Variables, offers Dutch and English AF3 presets with settings files plus a Dutch AH2 preset, supports local and Kodi-accessible network locations, and can retarget compatible Fen, Fen Light, Red Light, and POV plugin ids while preserving a restore backup before overwriting anything.
